title: Stale Markdown Evidence Purge v1 — Rig Relay

summary.notes: 109 stale Markdown evidence files deleted (108 docs/audits/ + 1 analysis_results.md). 4 restored because tests/scripts reference them — must update references to JSON counterparts before re-deletion. 1 kept per migration manifest (release-candidate-convergence-spine.md, references_updated: false). 61 governance Markdowns preserved as human-facing policy docs.

doctrine_applied.migration_rules: Old Markdown docs must not be deleted until: JSON replacement exists, validates against schema, static renderer renders it, migration manifest maps old_path to new_path, references updated, tests pass, deletion listed in final report.

docs_audits_stale.description: Pre-migration audit artifacts in docs/audits/. Every Markdown file has a canonical JSON counterpart in docs/json/audits/ with matching basename. These are obsolete human-readable audit artifacts superseded by schema-governed JSON.
docs_audits_stale.exception: docs/audits/release-candidate-convergence-spine.md — in migration manifest with references_updated: false. Must update references before deletion.

docs_governance_preserved.description: Governance policy documents in docs/governance/. 55 have canonical JSON counterparts in docs/json/governance/. 7 are explicitly preserved in the migration manifest. These are human-facing policy documents that serve as readable documentation even after JSON canonicalization.
docs_governance_preserved.rationale: Migration manifest explicitly preserves several governance Markdowns. These serve as human-facing policy docs. AGENTS.md treats governance Markdown as allowed human-facing documentation.

other_stale.description: analysis_results.md at repository root. 17KB of unstructured evidence output. No references. Not in manifest. No canonical counterpart. Appears to be a one-off analysis dump.
